THE HOUSE OF LAURENT PERRIER
WAS FOUNDED IN 1812 IN
TOURS-SUR-MARNE IN THE HEART OF
THE CHAMPAGNE REGION,
AND SO HAS ACCESS TO GRAPES
FROM THE GREATEST WINE
GROWING AREAS.
LAURENT PERRIER BRUT IS A BLEND
OF PINOT NOIR, PINOT MEUNIER
AND CHARDONNAY GRAPES.
IT HAS A PALE LEMON COLOUR,
EXCELLENT MOUSSE OF FINE BUBBLES
AND A FLORAL FRUITY BOUQUET.
THIS COMBINED WITH ITS NUTTY
FLAVOUR MAKES IT LONG AND
ELEGANT ON THE PALATE.
